extern "C" __global__ void noahmp_copy_slots(unsigned int* out, int n, const unsigned int* v0, const unsigned int* v1) { int c = blockDim.x*blockIdx.x+threadIdx.x; if(c>=n) return; out[(long long)c*4+0] = v0[(long long)c*(1)+(0)];
out[(long long)c*4+1] = v1[(long long)c*(1)+(0)];}

extern "C" __global__ void noahmp_copy_slots(unsigned int* out, int n, const unsigned int* v0) { int c = blockDim.x*blockIdx.x+threadIdx.x; if(c>=n) return; out[(long long)c*4+3] = v0[(long long)c*(1)+(0)];}
